title: Encoding and Propagation of Grammatical Number in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.07283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have become an increasingly popular means of translating Large Language Model (LLM) hidden state vectors into a human-comprehensible list of features or symbols. As such, SAEs may provide insight into an LLM's knowledge representation and internal ``mental'' grammar - topics of pragmatic interest for mechanistic interpretation of AI behavior and of theoretical interest for the study of in silico representations of human language. Language models with fewer than 100M parameters, trained on small corpora, nonetheless exhibit strong grammatical competence and discourse coherence, despite producing content of limited reliability. We use SAEs that we trained on one such model (Pythia-70M) to conduct an in-depth examination of how a single grammatical phenomenon, number agreement, is represented and processed in an LLM. We demonstrate the mechanism and the methodology by which SAEs can be used to find and propagate

translated_title: 大语言模型中语法数的编码与传播
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）已成为一种日益流行的方法，可将大语言模型（LLM）的隐藏状态向量转换为人类可理解的特征或符号列表。因此，SAEs 可以为我们洞察 LLM 的知识表示和内部“心智”语法提供途径——这对 AI 行为的机制性解释具有实践意义，对研究人类语言的计算机模拟表示也具有理论价值。参数少于 1 亿、仅在小语料库上训练的语言模型，尽管生成内容的可靠性有限，却仍表现出强大的语法能力和语篇连贯性。我们使用在这样一个模型（Pythia-70M）上训练的 SAE，深入研究单一语法现象——数的一致——在 LLM 中是如何被表示和处理的。我们展示了 SAE 可用于查找和传播语法特征的机制与方法。
tldr: 该研究利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）深入揭示了 Pythia-70M 小型语言模型中语法数一致现象的表示与处理机制，展示了 SAE 如何用于查找和传播语言模型内部的语法特征。
en_tdlr: This study uses sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to provide an in-depth examination of how grammatical number agreement is represented and processed in the Pythia-70M language model, demonstrating a mechanism and methodology for using SAEs to find and propagate grammatical features.
